definitions.gloss: the season leader in runs batted in
definitions.explanation: In baseball, the title given to the player who records the most runs batted in (RBIs) over a season.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{今年|ことし}の{打点|だてん}{王|おう}だ。
examples.english: He is this year's RBI leader.

examples.japanese: {打点|だてん}{王|おう}のタイトルを{取|と}る。
{四番|よんばん}{打者|だしゃ}が{百|ひゃく}{打点|だてん}を{超|こ}えて{打点|だてん}{王|おう}に{輝|かがや}いた。
examples.english: The cleanup hitter surpassed 100 RBIs to claim the RBI title.

notes:
Compound of {打点|だてん} (runs batted in, RBI) + {王|おう} (king). The title awarded to the player with the most RBIs in a season.

RELATED TITLES:
- {首位|しゅい}{打者|だしゃ}: batting champion
- {本塁打|ほんるいだ}{王|おう}: home run leader
- {盗塁|とうるい}{王|おう}: stolen base leader
